text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Planning Minister Ali al-Zmei'a chairs a meeting of senior officials to discuss the government's four-year work plan.
- Eight Iranians and an Iraqi arrested for illegal entry.

- The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) hails Kuwait's position towards Jordanian prisoners. Kuwait jailed tens of Jordanian and nationals of other Arab states after the 1990-91 Iragi occupation for collaboration with Iraqi troops.
- Kuwait Real Estate says mid-year net profit rose 120.7 percent to 3.5 million dinars ($11.5 million).
- Burgan Bank mid-year net profit expected at eight million dinars, over a 100 percent rise compared to the same period of 1996.
- Sit-in for POWs cause. Kuwait says Iraq is still holding some 600 Kuwaitis captured during the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of the Gulf state. Iraq denies.
